title: Spyglass: Now Officially Launched!
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing enhanced clarity and powerful new insights to all users.

title: Ultimate Control Over Your Embedded Files
summary: Gain ultimate control over your embedded files with new options to upload, remove, download, and customize their display directly within the editor.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap!
summary: Explore our dynamic new roadmap page to effortlessly track recent releases, preview upcoming features, and discover what exciting innovations are planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a more streamlined workflow with our newly designed checkboxes, now easier to click, effortlessly draggable, and beautifully updated to match our modern interface.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded our collaboration tools to make working with your team smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Effortless Collaboration & Shared Item Access
summary: We've made it significantly easier to discover and collaborate on shared content, ensuring all relevant items are always at your fingertips.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to support a diverse range of international languages, ensuring a truly global experience for all our users.

title: Noeko is now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering you with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's evolution.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflow with a reimagined knowledge map that offers advanced filtering by tags, time, and shared content.

summary: Discover and organize your information effortlessly with advanced filtering, sorting, and the ability to save your refined searches as custom knowledge collections.

title: Smarter Note Connections
summary: Experience a revolutionary way to organize your ideas with dynamic note layouts and interactive previews, making your linked content come alive.

title: Personalize Your Space with Stunning New Themes
summary: Transform your workspace with a suite of new and improved themes, designed to offer greater personalization and a visually stunning experience.

title: Spot-On Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're perfecting our application's greetings to always accurately reflect the time of day, enhancing your personalized experience with every visit.

title: Expanded Content Sources
